limitations: Results are valid only for the input sample and are not a hidden-test score.
The candidate table has no b-quark matching fields; b-jet inclusion is not evaluated.

definition.fake_to_true_ratio: selected non-truth triplets / selected truth-matched triplets
definition.mass_resolution: population standard deviation of triplet_mass for selected truth-matched triplets
definition.purity: selected truth-matched triplets / all selected triplets
definition.reconstruction_efficiency: selected truth-matched triplets / all truth-matched input triplets
